summary:
v0.3 Phase 3 (Match mode, scoring transparency, overflow, round-mode picker, per-mode leaderboard, Professor Flock avatar) end-to-end PASSED on both backend and frontend.

BACKEND (14/14 new e2e + 11/11 phase3 local + 5/5 scoring regression):
- Created /app/backend/tests/test_v03_phase3_e2e.py exercising the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
- /api/game/score sub-100 case (static_blog, no constraints, s3+cf+route53, long explanation) -> total<=100 and overflow_bonus=0.0.
- /api/game/score overflow case (same selection + constraint_ids=['scalable']) -> total==100 and overflow_bonus>0 (5.0 observed). NOTE for next agent: backend field is constraint_ids (NOT constraints); Pydantic silently drops the wrong key and you will see total=95 with overflow=0 if you mis-name it.
- Simplicity sub-score now carries state ('right_sized' | 'overengineered' | 'too_thin') and 'lost'. Right-sized 3-svc pick -> state=right_sized, lost=0.0. 6-svc pick (s3,cf,route53,ec2,rds,lambda) -> state=overengineered, lost>0 (score+lost ~= 10).
- v0.2.5 scoring regression: python -m tests.test_scoring 5/5 PASS. TC1 static_blog full ideal -> 90 Well-Architected; the other four bands intact.
- /api/learn/match/session?track=CLF_SAA returns exercises with slot_id/label/hint but no 'correct' field (verified in network response). Tray items have id/title/category.
- /api/learn/match/grade: perfect placement -> partial_score=100 and all per_slot status='correct'. Right-service-wrong-slot -> 'misplaced' for swapped slots, partial_score=33. Distractor -> 'wrong'; empty slot -> 'missing'. Unknown exercise_id -> 400.
- Leaderboard per-mode: same name+owner_token with rounds=3 and rounds=5 creates two separate rows with different ids. Lower score in same mode -> status 'kept' (no overwrite). Higher score in same mode -> status 'updated' with the same id. Different owner_token same name -> status 'conflict' with non-empty suggestions[].
- Guest mode (mode='guest') always inserts a fresh row with a new id even for repeat saves.
- DELETE /api/leaderboard/{id}?owner_token=... removes only that single mode entry; the sibling 5R row survives.
- Admin delete: missing token -> 403; valid X-Admin-Token=<ADMIN_TOKEN_REDACTED> -> 200 {deleted:true}.
- Test cleanup: module teardown + final loop deleted all TEST_ rows including legacy carry-over rows from iters 1-5 (TEST_v025_player, TEST_player, TEST_player2, TEST_v026_*). Leaderboard left at 0 TEST_ rows.

FRONTEND (Playwright, public URL):
- /play renders round-mode-select with round-mode-3 / round-mode-5 / round-mode-10. Clicking round-mode-3 starts a 3R game ('Round 1 / 3' in round-title).
- Deep link /play?rounds=5 auto-starts a 5R game ('Round 1 / 5' confirmed).
- ServiceCard list renders via data-testid=service-card-<id> (12 cards in hand). Picked 4 cards, filled explanation, submitted -> score-breakdown appeared with simplicity-tag = 'Simplicity Score: +10 / 10' (green, right-sized). overflow-bonus-note correctly absent on that sub-100 round.
- /learn/match: match-start visible with Professor Flock avatar img (src contains professor-flock). Click start-match-button -> match-play. Network capture confirmed /api/learn/match/session response has NO 'correct' key in any slot (PASS: no answer keys exposed). Tray (6 cards) + slots (3) for the static-site exercise; match-submit is correctly disabled until every slot is filled. After placement, submit enables, grading returns 33% '1/3' in match-exercise-score with 3 per-slot status badges and the Flock explanation pipeline-bottom.
- /leaderboard shows leaderboard-table with headers ['#','Player','3R Best','5R Best','10R Best'] (PASS Part E columns). admin-panel rendered.
- Mobile portrait 390x844: /leaderboard, /play picker, /learn/match play all have scrollWidth==innerWidth (390==390), NO full-page horizontal overflow.
- Professor Flock avatar: img with src*='professor-flock' rendered on Play round mentor area and on /learn/match match-start. learn-hero-flock element present on /learn (FlockAvatar uses /professor-flock.png; visible in screenshot at both hero and 'Professor Flock says' bubble).
- ZERO browser console errors and zero page errors across the Play, Match, and Leaderboard flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ScoreRequest uses field name 'constraint_ids' but the frontend and several callers might assume 'constraints'. Pydantic v2 silently ignores unknown fields and the score endpoint returns a default Constraint=10/20 with no error. Consider model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') on ScoreRequest, or add an alias so {'constraints': [...]} also binds. This silent drop bit the test suite once and would also silently mute any client that posts the wrong key.
Match grade endpoint validates exercise_id (400 on unknown). Good.
session_exercises strips 'correct' before returning. Good - verified at the network layer.
Leaderboard per-mode keyed by (name_key, rounds, mode) producing 3R/5R/10R/Guest separate rows. Lower-score kept, higher-score updated in place. Correct UX semantics.
Admin delete only takes the entry id; consider also exposing a bulk-by-name endpoint for moderation (current cleanup loop required one DELETE per id).

FlockAvatar on /learn hero (learn-hero-flock) carries the testid on a parent element rather than directly on the . Selector convenience would improve if data-testid='learn-hero-flock-img' were added to the img element too.
ScoreBreakdown renders 'Simplicity Score: +X / 10' green for right_sized state. Confirmed visually and via data-testid simplicity-tag. Overflow note correctly absent on sub-100 rounds.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all v0.3 Phase 3 acceptance criteria tested

test_credentials: Admin token <ADMIN_TOKEN_REDACTED> (X-Admin-Token header). Read from /app/backend/.env ADMIN_TOKEN and /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: All test rows TEST_iter6_* and legacy TEST_v025_player, TEST_player, TEST_player2, TEST_v026_* (9 stale rows) were admin-deleted at the end of the run. Leaderboard left with 0 TEST_ rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_v03_phase3_e2e.py tests/test_v03_phase3_scoring.py tests/test_v03_match.py -v (25 tests). Also python3 -m tests.test_scoring (5/5). IMPORTANT pitfall: POST /api/game/score wants field 'constraint_ids' (not 'constraints'); if you POST 'constraints' Pydantic silently drops it and you'll see total=95 with overflow=0 instead of 100/5. Match endpoint key is 'placements' object slot_id->service_id. Admin delete is DELETE /api/admin/leaderboard/{id} with header X-Admin-Token. Per-mode leaderboard key is (name_key, rounds, mode) where mode in {'official','guest'}; same name+token saves to different mode columns side by side. Frontend service cards render as data-testid=service-card-<id> inside data-testid=card-hand. Mobile breakpoint at 390px is clean - no page-level horizontal overflow on /play, /learn/match, or /leaderboard.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Single test-script-level fix during this iteration: initial e2e POSTs used field name 'constraints' which Pydantic dropped; corrected to 'constraint_ids' to match server.py ScoreRequest and tests now pass. Worth flagging back to the main agent as a minor API contract issue (suggest extra='forbid' or alias).
